questions.question: Which of God's own people does Amos 2 finally turn to judge?
What sins of Israel does Amos 2 list?
options: Selling the righteous for silver and the needy for a pair of sandals
Making secret treaties with the powerful kings of foreign lands
Refusing year after year to keep the appointed sacred feasts
Worshiping carved idols on the high places of the hills
questions.answer: Selling the righteous for silver and the needy for a pair of sandals
